meta.name: lsp-setup
meta.description: Configure a Language Server (LSP) for a specific language so editor/agent tooling — diagnostics, go-to-definition, find-references, rename — works. Use when you need to: configure LSP, lsp setup, set up or install a language server, fix 'no LSP server configured' / 'server not installed', choose between servers (basedpyright vs pyright vs ty vs ruff), or wire .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json. 언어서버 설정. Routes by file extension to references/<language>/README.md for the exact builtin server, per-OS install commands (macOS/Linux/Windows), config snippets for both config files, initialization options, alternatives, and troubleshooting. Ships scripts: detect-lsp.ts (scan a project for languages + each server's install/config status) and verify-lsp.ts (run a real diagnostics roundtrip). Covers typescript, python, go, rust, c/c++, java, kotlin, c#/razor, swift, ruby, php, dart, elixir, zig, lua, bash, yaml, terraform, haskell, julia.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 当你要给项目配置语言服务器时,Claude 会先判断项目语言,再按对应语言的参考文档给出安装命令、写出配置文件(如 .codex/lsp-client.json),并用脚本实际检测一次诊断功能是否可用。
howto.when: 当你提到“配置 LSP”、“安装语言服务器”、修复“no LSP server configured”等需求,或要求写入 .codex/lsp-client.json 之类的配置时触发。
howto.what_en: When asked to set up a language server, Claude identifies the project language, reads the matching reference, gives OS-specific install commands, writes the project config file, then runs a real diagnostics roundtrip to confirm it works.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention 'configure LSP', 'install a language server', fixing 'no LSP server configured', choosing between servers, or wiring .codex/lsp-client.json / .opencode/lsp.json.

say_en.text: Set up LSP for this TypeScript project and install typescript-language-server
say_en.note: Claude reads the TypeScript reference and runs install/config.

say_en.text: My .py file says no LSP server configured — fix it
Switch Python LSP to basedpyright in .opencode/lsp.json
